effects.description: (2 items) Adds 3-129 Weapon and Spell Damage
(4 items) Adds 3-129 Weapon and Spell Damage

(5 items) Whenever you kill an enemy you gain a damage shield that absorbs up to |cffffff3876|r damage for |cffffff10|r seconds and a stack of Wrath of Whitestrake for |cffffff10|r seconds.  Each stack of Wrath of Whitestrake grants you |cffffff2-100|r Weapon and Spell Damage, but causes you to take |cffffff159|r Oblivion damage every second, up to |cffffff10|r stacks.  The damage shield scales off the higher of your Weapon or Spell Damage, and the damage scales off your Max Health.
